annotation.justification: The clause is clear and unambiguous. It specifies a condition under which an origin server must not send a Date header field: when it lacks a clock capable of providing a reasonable approximation of the current time in Coordinated Universal Time. There is no room for multiple interpretations, and the constraint is concrete and actionable.
